-- GUI Ana Çerçevesi
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Ana Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 700)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Fonksiyon: Buton oluşturma
local function createButton(name, position, func)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 30)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, position * 35) -- Buton aralıkları
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = name
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Parent = MainFrame
    
    -- Tıklama işlemi
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

-- 7 Yeni Buton
-- 1. Yüksek Patlayan Blok
local function createHighExplosiveBlock()
    local block = Instance.new("Part")
    block.Size = Vector3.new(1, 100, 1)
    block.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0)
    block.Anchored = true
    block.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright orange")
    block.Parent = workspace

    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
    explosion.Position = block.Position
    explosion.BlastRadius = 50
    explosion.BlastPressure = 10000
    explosion.Parent = workspace
    wait(1)
    block:Destroy()
end

-- 2. Hareketli Blok
local function createMovingBlock()
    local block = Instance.new("Part")
    block.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
    block.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    block.Anchored = true
    block.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
    block.Parent = workspace

    local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local goal = {}
    goal.Position = block.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 50)  -- 50 stud ileriye hareket
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
    local tween = tweenService:Create(block, tweenInfo, goal)
    tween:Play()
end

-- 3. Yüksek Sesli Patlama
local function createLoudExplosion()
    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
    explosion.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
    explosion.BlastRadius = 50
    explosion.BlastPressure = 10000
    explosion.Parent = workspace

    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138175309" -- Bir patlama ses dosyası
    sound.Parent = workspace
    sound:Play()
end

-- 4. Renkli Işık
local function createColoredLight()
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    light.Range = 20
    light.Brightness = 5
    light.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
end

-- 5. Para Yağdırma
local function createMoneyRain()
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local coin = Instance.new("Part")
        coin.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        coin.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 50, math.random(-5, 5))
        coin.Anchored = true
        coin.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
        coin.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        coin.Parent = workspace

        -- Para düşme animasyonu
        local fallTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(coin, TweenInfo.new(2), {Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position})
        fallTween:Play()
    end
end

-- 6. Hızlı Koşma
local function enableSpeedBoost()
    local humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100  -- Hız artırma
        wait(5)  -- 5 saniye sonra eski hızına dönsün
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
    end
end

-- 7. Parlak Yıldız
local function createShiningStar()
    local star = Instance.new("Part")
    star.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
    star.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
    star.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    star.Anchored = true
    star.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
    star.Parent = workspace

    -- Parlaklık efekti
    local sparkles = Instance.new("Sparkles")
    sparkles.Parent = star
    sparkles.SparkleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

-- 8. Yüksek Patlayan Blok
local function createLongBarExplosive()
    local bar = Instance.new("Part")
    bar.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 100)
    bar.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
    bar.Anchored = true
    bar.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    bar.Parent = workspace
    wait(0.5)
    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
    explosion.Position = bar.Position
    explosion.BlastRadius = 50
    explosion.BlastPressure = 10000
    explosion.Parent = workspace
    bar:Destroy()
end

-- 9. Sembolik Blok (31 sayısı çıkaran blok)
local function create31SymbolBlock()
    local block = Instance.new("Part")
    block.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    block.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
    block.Anchored = true
    block.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    block.Parent = workspace
    block.Touched:Connect(function()
        print("31 Sayısı! 🟩")
        game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Chat"):Chat(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, "31 Sayısı!")
    end)
end

-- 10. Oturma Koltuğu ve Taşıma
local function createChair()
    local chair = Instance.new("Part")
    chair.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
    chair.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    chair.Anchored = true
    chair.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
    chair.Parent = workspace
    -- Koltuğa oturma animasyonu burada olabilir
end

-- Yeni butonları oluşturma
createButton("Yüksek Patlayan Blok", 1, createHighExplosiveBlock)
createButton("Hareketli Blok", 2, createMovingBlock)
createButton("Yüksek Sesli Patlama", 3, createLoudExplosion)
createButton("Renkli Işık", 4, createColoredLight)

local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", screenGui)  

-- Configure the TextLabel  
textLabel.Text = "sukuna"  
textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon -- Use Cartoon font for a sharper look  
textLabel.TextSize = 48  
textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- Red color  
textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1 -- Make the background transparent  
textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0) -- Position it at the top center of the screen  
textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) -- Set anchor point to center horizontally  
textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0 -- Add stroke to make it stand out (optional)  
textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) -- Black stroke for contrast (optional)  

-- Input handling  
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)  
    if gameProcessed then return end  

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then  
        local target = Mouse.Target  

        if target and target.Parent then  
            local head = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head")  
            local leftArm = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")  
            local rightArm = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")  
            local humanoid = target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")  

            if humanoid then  
                if head then  
                    head:Destroy()  
                end  
                if leftArm then  
                    leftArm:Destroy()  
                end  
                if rightArm then  
                    rightArm:Destroy()  
                end  
            end  
        end  
    end  
end)
